verdict: COMPLETE - UNCONDITIONAL: scalar Jacobi ODE, its explicit constant-curvature solutions, deriv-verified initial value problem, and ODE-level Rauch/Sturm comparison all kernel-checked; axiom cone exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; no sorry/axiom/unsafe/native_decide/proof_wanted.

definitions.jacobiSolSphere: fun K t => Real.sin (Real.sqrt K * t) / Real.sqrt K   -- K > 0 branch
definitions.jacobiSolHyperbolic: fun K t => Real.sinh (Real.sqrt (-K) * t) / Real.sqrt (-K)   -- K < 0 branch
definitions.jacobiSol: piecewise gluing: if 0 < K then sphere else if K = 0 then flat else hyperbolic
definitions.jacobiDeriv: explicit first derivative: cos (sqrt K * t) / 1 / cosh (sqrt (-K) * t)
definitions.SolvesJacobiODE: fun K j => forall t, deriv (deriv j) t + K * j t = 0
definitions.HasNormalizedInitial: fun j => j 0 = 0 and deriv j 0 = 1

claims.requirement: define the scalar Jacobi ODE j'' + K j = 0 and its three explicit solutions
claims.statement: jacobiSol K is the piecewise function sin(sqrt K t)/sqrt K (K>0), t (K=0), sinh(sqrt(-K) t)/sqrt(-K) (K<0); SolvesJacobiODE K j := forall t, deriv (deriv j) t + K * j t = 0; HasNormalizedInitial j := j 0 = 0 and deriv j 0 = 1.

claims.requirement: each explicit formula satisfies the ODE (sphere branch)
claims.statement: 0 < K -> forall t, deriv (deriv (jacobiSolSphere K)) t + K * jacobiSolSphere K t = 0

claims.requirement: each explicit formula satisfies the ODE (flat branch)
claims.statement: forall t, deriv (deriv jacobiSolFlat) t + 0 * jacobiSolFlat t = 0

claims.requirement: each explicit formula satisfies the ODE (hyperbolic branch)
claims.statement: K < 0 -> forall t, deriv (deriv (jacobiSolHyperbolic K)) t + K * jacobiSolHyperbolic K t = 0

claims.requirement: initial conditions j(0)=0, j'(0)=1 for each explicit formula
claims.statement: jacobiSolSphere K 0 = 0 and deriv (jacobiSolSphere K) 0 = 1 (K>0); jacobiSolFlat 0 = 0 and deriv jacobiSolFlat 0 = 1; jacobiSolHyperbolic K 0 = 0 and deriv (jacobiSolHyperbolic K) 0 = 1 (K<0)
claims.hypotheses: sign hypothesis on K for the corresponding branch

claims.requirement: glued piecewise solution satisfies the IVP for every real K
claims.statement: forall K, (jacobiSol K 0 = 0) and (deriv (jacobiSol K) 0 = 1) and (forall t, deriv (deriv (jacobiSol K)) t + K * jacobiSol K t = 0)

claims.requirement: pointwise comparison of the explicit first derivatives in K
claims.statement: K1 <= K2 -> 0 <= s -> (0 < K2 -> sqrt K2 * s <= pi) -> jacobiDeriv K2 s <= jacobiDeriv K1 s
claims.hypotheses: K1 <= K2, s >= 0, and s before the first zero when K2 > 0

claims.requirement: Rauch comparison up to the first zero
claims.statement: K1 <= K2 -> 0 <= t -> (0 < K2 -> t <= pi/sqrt K2) -> jacobiSol K2 t <= jacobiSol K1 t
claims.hypotheses: K1 <= K2, t >= 0, and t before the first zero when K2 > 0

claims.statement: rauch_comparison_sphere: K2 > 0 and t <= pi/sqrt K2; rauch_comparison_of_nonpos: K2 <= 0 and arbitrary t >= 0

claims.requirement: nonnegativity up to the first zero, and the first zero itself
claims.statement: 0 <= t -> (0 < K -> t <= pi/sqrt K) -> 0 <= jacobiSol K t; and 0 < K -> jacobiSol K (pi/sqrt K) = 0
